gotchas: Sign-in at app.asana.com/-/login is email-first: input[type=email] then Enter, then input[type=password] then Enter. No new-device code and no reCAPTCHA were asked on 2026-10-11.

Onboarding is driven by [role=button] divs, not <button>s: Continue, Back and 'Go to Asana' are all [role=button]. The layout step's radios are filled by clicking their <label>; Continue is aria-disabled until then.

The workspace starts on a trial ('days left'); the sidebar's 'Add billing info' [role=button] opens the plan picker. Each plan has a Select [role=button]; the one containing 'Starter' (nth=0) opens a Stripe Payment Element.

Card number, expiry and CVC are all in the first iframe whose title contains 'Secure' (autocomplete cc-number / cc-exp / cc-csc). Fill expiry first, then number, then CVC as the very next field. The submit is [role=button] 'Confirm'.
Verified 2026-10-11 through the staging proxy with the public test card under a verification-only key: expiry, number and CVC filled (card_fields_verified). Stopped before Confirm.

route.note: A new account lands on a short onboarding: a first step with one text input (what you're working on) whose Continue works with the field left empty, then a 'Let's…' layout step with three radio options (Continue stays aria-disabled until one is picked; click its label), then an 'Invite your team' step: leave the invite inputs empty and press 'Go to Asana'.
